node.title: Amazon Q VS Code Extension Compromised with Malicious Code
node.excerpt: Amazon Q VS Code extension v1.84.0 was compromised with a malicious commit that could trigger destructive AI-generated commands.

node.title: Malicious AI Models Hit PyPI
node.excerpt: Attackers are hiding malware inside PyTorch models in PyPI packages mimicking Alibaba’s Aliyun. Once installed, the payload exfiltrates system data, highlighting the growing risk of malicious AI in developer tools.
